content: Iböŋ u mɛɛn
Mbuur awà an'sà làkwikilà naa Yɛsu wà Klistɔ, bàmubɔr amu Nzam, anà mbuur awà akwen Taa, mbuur afàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈, nde afàkwen sye mbuur bàbɔ̈r amu Nzam.
Muyöb naa bi ikwen baan a Nzam, bi ikwen Nzam anà isyääl nswɛɛŋ ande.
Ntɔn mukwen Nzam yà mukwey nswɛɛŋ ande. Nswɛɛŋ ande ayi buur batɛy,
ntɔn mbuur wanswà bàbör amu Nzam, wà ŋiböŋ u mɛɛn. Anà mbwo muwal iböŋ u mɛɛn yà làkwikilà abi.
Nà awà ŋiböŋ u mɛɛn, isàkɔɔn akal mbuur afàsà làkwikilà naa Yɛsu wà Mwan a Nzam?
Imbäl ntɔn Yɛsu Klistɔ
Yɛsu Klistɔ wà mbuur kàyi u mbwo a an'dà anà an'kil, kà nà unsà an'dà mpɛl anki, wɛɛ unsà an'dà anà an'kil, anà Dweelà ataa imbäl, ntɔn Dweelà wàndandaa.
Abun, ba batär bàmutà imbäl,
dweelà, an'dà anà an'kil, bya byàtär byà mwɛy.
Isàkal naa bi ban'kyey imbäl a baar, imbäl a Nzam kyà kyàkölàköl, ntɔn kya kyà imbäl a Nzam, nde imbäl aki kàtɛ ntɔn Mwan ande.

Mbuur awe anà làkwikilà akà Mwan a Nzam, nde we anà imbäl aki amu nde ŋakwo. Wɛɛ mbuur akɔ̈ɔ̈n làkwikilà, Nzam afun'buul mbuur a loor, ntɔn nde làkwikilà latɛy unsà imbäl kàtɛ Nzam ntɔn Mwan ande.
Le imbäl ki: Nzam kipɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye, wɛɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ wà amu Mwan ande.
Mbuur awe anà Mwan we anà mɔ̈ɔ̈, mbuur awà akɔ̈ɔ̈n Mwan a Nzam, nde mɔ̈ɔ̈ watɛy.
Mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye
Amàlasöön mɛ indiir abi yà ntɔn naa bɛ làyöb naa bɛ labye anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye, bɛ baar làbye anà làkwikilà kà ikɔb a Mwan a Nzam.
Apan, làkyän ibà bi alà kusà a nde lalà: isàkal naa bi ban'lɔm undiir asànaa abà ukwen ande, nde akyer afiwem.
Anà, isàkal naa bi ikyàyöb naa nde akyer afiwem, bi ibye anà làkyän naa bi ban'wal undiir kan'lɔm bi akà nde.

Isàkal naa mbuur an'man un'tɔŋ ande wàmukyer man'be, man'be mpa ifàtwaal ukwà, wɛy nde uyamà, waa Nzam usun'pà mɔ̈ɔ̈, isàkal naa ndandaa man'be kan'kyer nde mun'syen anki kà ukwà. Wɛɛ mye anà man'be màfàsyen mbuur kà ukwà, kà ntɔn man'be a tub amà anki mɛ in'tɛɛnà muyamà.
Ube banswà bà man'be, wɛɛ man'be manswà ifàsyen anki kà ukwà.
Bi ikyàyöb naa mbuur wanswà awà bàbɔ̈r amu Nzam ufàfàkyer anki man'be, ntɔn Mwan a Nzam nde ŋakwo akyer afun'tii. Wɛɛ Un'be kun'kyer anki akà undiir mwɛy.
Bi ikyàyöb naa bi ibà baan a Nzam, wɛɛ mɛɛn manswà mà ungyɛl a imwol a Un'be.

Bi ikyàyöb naa Mwan a Nzam kàkyàyà anà kipɛ un'yɛnà ntɔn muyöb Nzam a ndandaa. Abun, bi ibà uboo a Ndandaa, amu Mwan ande Yɛsu Klistɔ, Nde wà Ndandaa, nde wà Nzam anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye.
Baan amɛ, làkäl bɛ ŋakwo ukwɛl anà itɛk.
